'''Bill Ruck''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Madison tournament]] on 14 July 2001, according to Brandon Schele's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2635">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-madison-wi-7-14-01-the-blind-approachd2635/ madison-wi-7-14-01-the-blind-approach], DeckTech (Brandon "Jedi Genius" Schele, 15 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-madison-wi-7-14-01-the-blind-approachd2635/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
